### 步骤

   对每个 condition (12 = 2 datasets × 6 attacks)：
   - 生成所有 K=5 panels (C(15,5)=3003)
   - 计算每个 panel 的：panel ASR (majority vote), K_eff (canonical MI-based), η_max

       }, ...

   }
